name: Being Careful
overview: Scripture calls believers to live with careful discernment and wisdom, walking circumspectly and not as fools but as those who are wise (Ephesians 5:15). This carefulness includes guarding against being led astray by worldly philosophies and deceit that are not grounded in Christ (Colossians 2:8). Walking in the Spirit empowers the believer to resist fulfilling the lusts of the flesh (Galatians 5:16), and knowing the good to do but failing to do it is sin (James 4:17). The righteous influence others positively, in contrast to the wicked who seduce and mislead (Proverbs 12:26), highlighting the importance of careful living in alignment with God’s revelation (Revelation 1:1).
